ownership.quote: Contabo GmbH, München, Amtsgericht München HRB 180722

stage.note: No press, Crunchbase/Tracxn hit, or investor announcement of any external equity/VC round was found after web and commercial-register searches. Register (Handelsregister via northdata.de) shows only registered share-capital (Stammkapital) increases funded internally (25,000€ in 2009 to 400,000€ in 2014), consistent with a founder/owner-operated German hosting company (founded 2003, Munich) rather than VC-backed growth. Treated as bootstrapped by default/absence of evidence rather than a confirmed public statement that it is self-funded.

note: Contabo is a privately-held German cloud/VPS and dedicated-server hosting company (Contabo GmbH), headquartered in Munich, founded in 2003 (per third-party review site sueddeutsche.de). It markets itself as 'a leading made-in-Germany cloud services provider' (Trustpilot company description). No evidence of VC/PE funding, an accelerator program, or acquisition by another company was found; it appears to be an independent, founder-operated business, though no primary source explicitly confirms 'bootstrapped' status or discloses financials — treat funding/revenue fields as unknown rather than zero.
